sql.query: SELECT c.id,c.conversationType,c.workflowId,c.teamId,COALESCE(w.workflowName,t.teamName,c.conversationName) conversationName FROM tbl_chat_conversations c LEFT JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.id=c.workflowId AND w.tenantId=c.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_teams t ON t.id=c.teamId AND t.tenantId=c.tenantId WHERE c.tenantId=:tenantId AND c.conversationType=:contextType AND ((c.conversationType='workflow' AND c.workflowId=:contextId) OR (c.conversationType='team' AND c.teamId=:contextId2)) AND c.isActive=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='TEAM_CHAT' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=c.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='chat.view' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=c.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) AND (c.conversationType='workflow' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles adminRole INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=adminRole.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') AND r.isActive=1 WHERE adminRole.userId=:adminUser AND adminRole.tenantId=c.tenantId AND adminRole.isActive=1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_team_members member ON member.userTenantId=ut.id AND member.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND member.teamId=c.teamId AND member.isActive=1 WHERE ut.userId=:memberUser AND ut.tenantId=c.tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active')) LIMIT 1

SELECT msg.id,msg.messageCiphertext,msg.messageIv,msg.messageAuthTag,msg.messageKeyVersion,msg.conversationId messageConversationId,msg.createdDate,msg.senderUserId,COALESCE(u.displayName,CONCAT_WS(' ',u.fName,u.lName),u.email) senderName,CAST(msg.senderUserId=:currentUser AS UNSIGNED) isMine FROM tbl_chat_messages msg INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=msg.senderUserId WHERE msg.tenantId=:tenantId AND msg.conversationId=:conversationId AND msg.isDeleted=0 AND :conversationCount>0 ORDER BY msg.id DESC LIMIT 100
